message.text: Record the accepted operational policy: processing is at-least-once with event_id deduplication; alert at oldest-outbox age 120 seconds; pause noncritical producers at 300 seconds; replay only after root cause mitigation. Mira owns receiver/outbox, Leon owns consumers/load testing, Saanvi owns operations. Produce an implementation sequence with acceptance checks and clearly separate unapproved recommendations.
